about: Silhouette Factions: the faction, tier and archetype of each preset in "Silhouette Factions.xml" (tools/pool/factions.py, S-72).

bos.look: a drilled army, well fed: fit soldiers and heavy knights, softer scribes

minutemen.look: farmers turned militia: sturdy, work-strong, ordinary

disciples.look: the Disciples: knife-lean, sinewy, all tendon

operators.look: the Operators: sleek, styled, better fed than the other gangs

triggermen.look: Skinny Malone's mob: well fed and a little soft

raiders.look: raiders: underfed, wiry, chem-worn, and the odd brute

institute.look: the Institute: well fed, sedentary, soft

atom.look: the Children of Atom: gaunt, ascetic, radiation-worn
